blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Variability in syntactic structure and parsing ambiguity are fundamental aspects of natural language which modern LLMs have to learn to deal with proficiently. Previous "post-mortem" studies have shown that fully trained Transformers indeed approximate canonical parsing algorithms such as inside-outside, but little is established theoretically about how this is actually learned. Here, we make a first step towards addressing this by studying the learning dynamics in synthetic context-free grammars with variable parse tree topology. The stagewise learning curves are fully interpretable, in the sense that all of the loss stages a) can be computed analytically, and b) can be clearly associated to the representation of a hidden latent tree variable, which allows to lift ambiguity and utilize information from wider contexts. By probing representations, we visualize the emergence of inside-outside computation across depth and during training: while during early stages local (bigram/trigram) information is used and involves only a few initial layers, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the most abstract latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final token prediction. This organization of computation is reminiscent of findings in real-world LLMs, and importantly applies here to a synthetic model which allows full analytical control of the data statistics, thus opening the door to theoretical progress.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Natural language is syntactically ambiguous . Grammars have evolved to optimize efficient communication while balancing complexity and ambiguity ( Hahn et al., 2020 ; Gibson et al., 2019 ) , but as a result many commonplace linguistic constructions are inherently problematic. A classic example in English is prepositional phrase attachment: the phrase “I saw him with the binoculars”, has two equally valid interpretations, each of which corresponds to a distinct parse tree. This is an example of unresolvable ambiguity, at least at the sentence level. For an LLM predicting the next token, there are plenty of examples where the sentence may be locally problematic, but where this can be resolved given sufficient grammar knowledge. For example, in the simple example of Subject-Verb agreement sketched in Fig. 1(a) , attending to any of the closest nouns leads to a wrong prediction; if the entire sentence is parsed correctly, however, the subject is identified and the spurious local cues cease to be problematic.
blocks.zh: 自然语言在战术上是模糊不清的。 语法发展为优化高效沟通,同时平衡复杂性和模糊性(Hahn等人,2020年;Gibson等人,2019年),但因此许多常见的语言构造本身就有问题. 英文的一个经典例子是前置短语附件:“我用望远镜看见他”一语有两种同样有效的解释,每种解释都对应一棵明显的剖面树。 这是一个无法解决的模棱两可的例子,至少在句子层面是如此. 对于LLM预测下一个符号来说,有很多例子说明句子在当地可能存在问题,但如果有足够的语法知识,这一点是可以解决的. 例如,在图1(a)中草图的Object-Verb协议的简单例子中,关注任何最接近的名词都会导致错误的预测;但是,如果整个句子被正确解析,则该主题被识别出来,而虚假的本地提示不再有问题.

blocks.en: There is a vast amount of work, which we will not review here, inspired by the question of how modern LLMs deal with aspects of syntax. Many works have emphasized how Transformers struggle with syntactic generalization ( Yao and Koller, 2022 ) , while others have shown the rich representation of syntax by probing activations in state-of-the art models ( Manning et al., 2020 ) . Studying such questions cleanly “in the wild”, however, is notoriously difficult. Although some successes have been reported in identifying specific syntax-related circuits ( Ferrando and Costa-jussà, 2024 ) , recovering and interpreting such circuits more generally remains challenging, often requiring manual intervention and human judgment ( Ameisen et al., 2025 ; Lindsey et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 有许多工作,我们不在这里审查,这是受现代法学硕士如何处理语法方面问题启发的。 许多作品都强调变形人如何与合成通论斗争(姚和柯勒,2022年),而其他作品则通过在最先进的艺术模型中探索激活来展现语法的丰富代表性(Manning等人,2020年). 然而,“在野外”对这些问题进行彻底的研究却十分困难。 虽然据报告在识别与语法有关的特定电路(Ferrando and Costa-jussà, 2024)方面取得了一些成功,但更普遍地恢复和解释这种电路仍然具有挑战性,往往需要人工干预和人力判断(Ameisen等人,2025年;Lindsey等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Mathematically, if we model language with a probabilistic-context-free-grammar (PCFG), the question can be phrased as whether and how LLMs learn canonical parsing algorithms to deal with syntax. PCFGs, originating in formal language theory ( Chomsky, 1957 ) , simply define a set of grammar rules with a corresponding probability. In computational linguistics, the associated canonical algorithm for dealing with syntactic ambiguity is the inside-outside algorithm (I-O) ( Baker, 1979 ) . From an inference perspective, this constitutes the Bayes-optimal algorithm to perform masked token prediction given data generated from a PCFG ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 从数学上讲,如果我们用概率-文本-无语法(PCFG)来建模语言,那么这个问题可以被说成是LLMs是否和如何学习词汇解析算法来处理语法. PCFGs起源于形式语言理论(Chomsky,1957),只是定义了一套具有相应概率的语法规则. 在计算语言学中,处理合成模糊性的相关学说算法是内向外算法(I-O)(Baker,1979 ). 从推论的角度来看,这构成Bayes-opperatal算法,以进行由PCFG生成的数据(Zhao等人,2023年)提供的蒙面符号预测。

blocks.en: Some previous works have attempted to ask precisely the question of whether and how inside-outside is implemented in Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) -based language models, mainly ( Allen-Zhu and Li, 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ) . ( Allen-Zhu and Li, 2025 ) , in particular, performed “post-mortem” interpretability analysis on the attention patterns of the language model, showing that it mimics dynamic programming (i.e. inside-outside), but sheds little light on the learning dynamics or the organization of latent information and outside computation across depth. In a recent paper, ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) does study latent structure across depth, but the experiments were limited to (next-) token prediction on a fixed-tree topology. Finally, and perhaps most importantly, although all these works consider some form of synthetic grammar none provide any analytical/quantitative control over the generative process, i.e. the data statistics induced by the grammar or associated language.
blocks.zh: 前几部作品试图准确询问"变形金刚"(Vaswani等人,2017年)-基于语言模型(Allen-Zhu和Li,2025年;Zhao等人,2023年)中是否以及如何实施内部-外部的问题. 特别是(Allen-Zhu和Li,2025年),对语言模型的注意力模式进行了“死后”可解释性分析,显示它模仿动态编程(即内向外),但对学习动态或潜在信息的组织以及外部计算的跨深度却很少说明. 在最近的一篇论文(周等人,2026年)中,确实研究了跨越深度的潜伏结构,但实验仅限于(接下来)对固定树木地形的象征性预测. 最后,也许最重要的是,尽管所有这些著作都考虑了某种形式的合成语法,但没有对基因过程,即语法或相关语言引发的数据统计,提供任何分析/定量控制.

blocks.en: As an initial step towards filling this gap, we study here the learning dynamics of a family of synthetic PCFGs introduced in ( Parley et al., 2026 ) . The key ingredients of this model, which is an extension of the model of ( Cagnetta et al., 2024 ) to varying-tree topologies (thus allowing for syntactic ambiguity), are twofold: it is layered, and the grammar is built by sampling rules uniformly without replacement from a finite pool of nonterminal symbols. These two ingredients are key to opening the door for interpretability: the randomness of the rules allows for analytical calculations, while, together with the layered structure, a hierarchy of correlation strengths is built into the grammar, in turn inducing a stagewise interpretable learning of the token-prediction task.
blocks.zh: 作为填补这一空白的第一步,我们在此研究在(Parley等人,2026年)中引入的合成PCFGs家族的学习动态。 这个模型的关键成分是将(Cagnetta等人,2024年)的模型延伸至不同树木的地形(从而允许合成的模糊性),是双重的:它是分层的,语法由采样规则统一构建,没有从有限的非记名符号集合中替换. 这两个成分是打开可解释性之门的关键:规则的随机性允许分析计算,同时与分层结构一起,在语法中构建了相关优势的层次,反过来又诱导了对符号-预测任务的分阶段可解释学习.

blocks.en: Building on this interpretable stagewise learning, we will show that with these very simple ingredients, our model of data is rich enough to recover some salient features of the way language computation has been found to be organized in LLMs. While during the early stages of training purely local statistics (bigram/trigram) is used and only the initial layers of the Transformer are active, gradually the Transformer develops an encoder-decoder structure where the deepest latent information is encoded in the middle, and the latter half of the network is used to progressively refine the final prediction. This echoes the general picture which has emerged empirically regarding the functional differentiation of layers in Transformer language models: early layers tend to encode local and surface-level information, while intermediate and deeper layers progressively integrate more abstract, contextual, and hierarchical representations ( Tenney et al., 2019 ; Jawahar et al., 2019 ; Kervadec et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于这种可解释的阶段性学习,我们将显示,通过这些非常简单的成分,我们的数据模型足够丰富,可以恢复语言计算法在LLMs中的一些显著特征。 虽然在培训初期使用纯粹的本地统计(bigram/trigram),只有变形器的初始层活动,但变形器逐渐发展出编码器-解码器结构,其中最深潜信息在中间编码,后半部分网络用于逐步完善最终预测. 这与变形语模型中层的功能区别经验性出现的总体情况相呼应:早期层倾向于编码局部和表层信息,而中间层和深层则逐渐融合了更多的抽象,上下文和分层代表(Tenney等人,2019年;Jawahar等人,2019年;Kervadec等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Although inside-outside computation clearly does not account for all of natural language processing, what we wish to emphasize is that we recover this rich behaviour in a synthetic model which allows for complete analytical/quantitative control over all statistics, and in particular allows to compute all correlations relevant for learning. This was done in ( Parley et al., 2026 ) already in the context of supervised learning. We will thus argue that our data model can potentially open the door to building quantitative theories of many interesting phenomena related to syntax and parsing in LLMs.
blocks.zh: 虽然内部外的计算显然不包含所有自然语言处理,但我们希望强调的是,我们用一个合成模型来恢复这种丰富的行为,这个模型可以对所有统计进行完整的分析/定量控制,特别是可以计算与学习有关的所有关联。 这在(Parley等人,2026年)已经是在监督学习的背景下进行的。 因此,我们将争辩说,我们的数据模型有可能为建立与语法和LLMs分析有关的许多有趣的现象的数量理论打开大门。

blocks.en: As sketched in Fig. 2 , we consider the following training/evaluation setup. Our Transformers can be trained on either sentences with arbitrary tree topology from the VT-RHM with p 2 = p 3 = 1 / 2 p_{2}{=}p_{3}{=}1/2 , i.e. equally probable binary/ternary branchings, or sentences derived only from the strictly ternary fixed-tree topology ( p 3 = 1 p_{3}=1 ). In both cases, we test for sentence completion on a disjoint set of sentences with ternary fixed-tree topology. In compact notation, therefore, 𝐗 train ∼ { 𝒫 VT , 𝒫 ter } , 𝐗 test ∼ 𝒫 ter \mathbf{X}_{\rm{train}}\sim\{\mathcal{P}_{\rm{VT}},\ \mathcal{P}_{\rm{ter}}\},\quad\mathbf{X}_{\rm{test}}\sim\mathcal{P}_{\rm{ter}} (9) where 𝒫 VT \mathcal{P}_{\rm{VT}} and 𝒫 ter \mathcal{P}_{\rm{ter}} correspond respectively to the sentence distribution induced by setting ( p 2 = p 3 = 1 / 2 ) (p_{2}=p_{3}=1/2) and ( p 2 = 0 , p 3 = 1 ) (p_{2}=0,p_{3}=1) for a fixed grammar instance. The rationale for evaluating on the ternary test set is, besides benchmarking, the following. Considering the varying-tree dataset as a task mixture, where each task is sentence completion on a different tree topology, the ternary tree is the last and most difficult to generalize to, hence constituting the bottleneck for complete learning. This has two reasons: firstly, simply because of the model definition, the number of ternary rules m 3 m_{3} per symbol is significantly larger than the number of binary rules m 2 m_{2} , so that the associated correlations for learning are weaker (as shown for classification in ( Parley et al., 2026 ) ) and the Transformer thus requires more data to acquire these rules. Secondly, in the varying-tree dataset the ternary topology is in fact very rare, with probability p 3 13 = 2 − 13 ≈ 10 − 4 p_{3}^{13}=2^{-13}\approx 10^{-4} . We are thus evaluating genuine structural generalization to a practically unseen topology or circuit.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment details
blocks.zh: 4 实验细节

blocks.en: We employ GPT-2-style Transformers ( Radford et al., 2019 ) , consisting of D D stacked blocks, each comprising causal (i.e. “decoder-only”) multi-head self-attention and a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP), with pre-layer normalization and residual connections. The MLPs use ReLU activations. We refer to each such block as a “layer” of the Transformer throughout this work, so that a Transformer of depth D D consists of D D such layers.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-2风格的变形器(Radford等人,2019年),由D D堆积的块组成,每个块都由因果(即只有“解码器”)多头自觉和向导多层感官(MLP)组成,具有前层正常化和剩余连接. MLPs使用ReLU激活. 我们在整个工作中将每个这样的块称为变形器的“层”,这样深度DD的变形器就由DD这样的层组成。

blocks.en: All our experiments below are performed for a VT-RHM grammar instance with L = 3 L=3 , and grammar parameters v = 8 , f = 1 / 4 v=8,f=1/4 . To accommodate all sentence lengths, we fix the context window to T = 26 = 3 L − 1 T=26=3^{L}-1 . For the ternary topology, the prefix x 1 , … ​ x d − 1 x_{1},\dots x_{d-1} fills up the entire window, while for shorter sentences we simply pad with zeros to the left. We consider a fixed batch size B = 128 B=128 , and online learning using Adam ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) , optimizing over learning rate and weight decay. We further make standard parameter choices for embedding dimension, number of heads and hidden size of the MLP: d emb = 512 d_{\rm emb}=512 ( 256 256 for D = 12 D=12 ), n h = 16 n_{h}=16 and d m ​ l ​ p = 4 × d emb d_{mlp}=4\times d_{\rm emb} . We consider learnable positional embeddings. The last-token prediction is read off from the final position at the last layer, and other positions are not trained on (as they would be for next-token prediction).

blocks.en: 5 Loss stages
blocks.zh: 页:1 损失阶段

blocks.en: In Fig. 1(c) , we show the learning curves for our GPT-2 style Transformers evaluated on the ternary sentence completion task. Strikingly, the last-token cross-entropy test loss shows a clear stagewise behaviour. The key insight in ( Cagnetta et al., 2024 ) was to show that such stages can be understood by considering the relative strength of correlation between the last token and preceding segments of the sentence, which can be used to build representations of the hidden latent tree variables. In ( Cagnetta et al., 2024 ) , these insights were developed into a theory of sample complexity (i.e. number of data required) of each learning stage. Here, we will leave open a precise mathematical characterization of sample complexity, but build on these ideas to interpret the varying-tree learning curves: in Sec. 6 , we will confirm by probing that each stage indeed can be associated to the emergence of the corresponding hidden variable representation.
blocks.zh: 在图1(c)中,我们显示了我们GPT-2风格的学习曲线,在三句完成任务上评价了变形器。 令人惊叹的是,最后的交替测试丢失显示出明显的阶段行为. 其中的关键见解(Cagnetta等人,2024年)是表明,可以通过考虑句子中最后一个符号和前几个部分之间的相对关联强度来理解这些阶段,这可以用来构建隐藏的潜在树变量的表示. 在(Cagnetta et al., 2024)中,这些见解被发展成为每个学习阶段的样本复杂性理论(即所需数据的数量). 在此,我们将对样本复杂性进行精确的数学定性,但基于这些想法来解释不同树木的学习曲线:在Sec.6中,我们将通过探究每个阶段确实可以和相应的隐藏变量的出现联系起来来确认.

blocks.en: In the initial learning stage, the Transformer exploits trigram statistics to predict the last token. For the fixed-tree ( p 2 = 0 p_{2}=0 , p 3 = 1 p_{3}=1 ), the corresponding loss can be estimated by counting the number of compatible last-token candidates, following ( Cagnetta and Wyart, 2024 ) . For the varying tree, however, the final trigram ( a ​ b ​ c ) (abc) can admit two distinct derivations: (i) directly through a ternary rule ( z → a ​ b ​ c ) (z\to abc) , or (ii) through a binary rule ( z ′ → b ​ c ) (z^{\prime}\to bc) , preceded by a subtree whose expansion ends with a a . When p 2 = p 3 = 1 / 2 p_{2}=p_{3}=1/2 and f 2 = f 3 = f f_{2}=f_{3}=f , these two configurations contribute comparable probabilities, leading to a higher trigram loss.

blocks.en: To open the door to interpretability, we now perform linear probing experiments on the residual-stream activations of the Transformer. We will first briefly introduce our probing method, and then present its two applications. On the one hand, it will allow us to test our understanding of the learning stages as arising from the representation of deeper and deeper (or more and more abstract) hidden grammatical structure. On the other hand, it will allow us to visualize cleanly the inside-outside organization of computation across depth, which we will do by tracking the improvement of the last-token probe loss.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions and open directions
blocks.zh: 7. 结论和开放方向

blocks.en: How do LLMs build up hierarchical representations of language, and end up mimicking highly non-trivial parsing algorithms from computational linguistics? Inspired by this question, we have analyzed the learning of inside-outside computation by GPT-2 style Transformers on a synthetic, controlled grammar, the VT-RHM ( Parley et al., 2026 ) . We developed an understanding of the loss stages, and contrasted fixed-tree and varying-tree training protocols, highlighting the stark distinctions in learned computational circuits. Our main interpretability result, captured in Fig. 4 , regards organization of computation across depth: we can cleanly show that, while during early stages of training (bigram/trigram) only initial layers are involved, the Transformer later develops a clear encoder-decoder structure, with the middle layers encoding the most abstract information and the latter half of the network progressively refining the token prediction. This general behavior echoes findings in real-world language models ( Tenney et al., 2019 ; Jawahar et al., 2019 ; Kervadec et al., 2026 ) , which is remarkable, especially given the fact that the VT-RHM is built from very simple ingredients and allows for analytical understanding of all relevant statistics ( Parley et al., 2026 ) . We argue that this opens the door to using the VT-RHM for building quantitative descriptions of various phenomena, which we include in the following open directions:
blocks.zh: LLMs 如何建立语言的分级表示,最后从计算语言学中模仿高度非三角解析算法? 在这个问题的启发下,我们分析了GPT-2风格变形器在合成的,可控的语法,VT-RHM(Parley等人,2026年)上对内向外计算学的学习. 我们对损失阶段有了了解,并对比了固定树木和不同树木的训练规程,突出强调了所学计算电路的鲜明区别。 我们的主要可解释性结果,在图4中,关于计算组织跨深度:我们可以明确显示,在培训的早期阶段(bigram/trigram),只涉及初始层,而变形器后来发展出一个清晰的编码器-解码器结构,中间层编码最抽象的信息,后半部分网络逐渐完善符号预测. 这种一般行为与现实世界语言模型中的结论相呼应(Tenney等人,2019年;Jawahar等人,2019年;Kervadec等人,2026年),这令人瞩目,特别是考虑到VT-RHM是用非常简单的成分构建的,并允许分析理解所有相关统计数据(Parley等人,2026年). 我们提出,这为利用VT-RHM对各种现象进行定量描述打开了大门,我们在以下开放方向中包括:

blocks.en: Learning algorithm and sample complexity of token prediction. For the supervised root classification problem ( Parley et al., 2026 ) , it was shown that, at least in the regime of large vocabulary size and number of rules, the rules of the VT-RHM are provably learned by a layerwise algorithm based on clustering by correlation, with an associated sample complexity scale (number of data). Extending this to last or next-token prediction, it will be important to understand whether a similar formal learning result can be established, and whether it requires thinking beyond a strictly layerwise algorithm. Furthermore, it will be interesting to characterize precisely which latent-token correlations must be used to build the outside pass (decoder) in a sample-efficient manner.
blocks.zh: 学习算法和符号预测的样本复杂性. 对于受监督的根分类问题(Parley et al., 2026),有证据表明,至少在大词汇大小和规则数的制度中,VT-RHM的规则通过基于关联的分组的分层算法可以证明是学习到的,并具有相关的样本复杂性尺度(数据数量). 将此扩展至持久或下接的预测,重要的是要了解是否可以建立类似的正式学习结果,以及是否需要超越严格层次的算法进行思考. 此外,准确描述必须使用何种潜在-托式关联来以高效样本方式建造外部通道(解码器)将很有趣。

blocks.en: Representation geometry. Although we have tested the expected correspondence between latent representations and learning stages, we have not studied how the Transformer actually encodes the relevant information. Our controlled grammar may give insight into the origin of syntactic encoding in LLMs: in ( Diego-Simón et al., 2024 ) , it was found that syntactic relations are encoded by the relative direction between embeddings, but it is not understood how such representations are learned.
blocks.zh: 代表几何学. 虽然我们测试了潜在表达和学习阶段之间的预期对应关系,但我们没有研究变形器如何实际编码相关信息。 我们受控的语法也许可以深入了解LLMs中合成编码的起源:在(Diego-Simón等人,2024年)中,发现合成关系是由嵌入物之间的相对方向编码的,但人们不明白这种表示是如何学习的.

blocks.en: Thresholds to syntactic generalization. In Fig. 4 , we have only considered the two “extreme” forms of training, i.e. fixed-tree vs the full varying-tree dataset. A natural question that arises is how the Transformer computation evolves between the two: how rich does the tree mixture need to be in order to impose encoder-decoder structure? This may also shed quantitative insight into phenomena such as Grokking of hierarchical (i.e. tree-like) structure in Transformers ( Murty et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 阈值为合成通论. 在图4中,我们只考虑了两种“极端”形式的培训,即固定树木与完整的不同树木数据集。 一个自然产生的问题是变形器计算如何在二者之间演化:树的混合物需要多丰富才能强制编码器-解码器结构? 这也可能对变形器(Murty et al., 2023)中的等级结构(即树状结构)的Grokking等现象进行定量透视.
